# The Oman Times

> > The Oman Times delivers breaking news on Oman, Middle East geopolitics, Asian markets, and international affairs with live coverage and expert analysis.

The Oman Times is a comprehensive news portal covering regional and global news with particular focus on Middle East tensions, energy markets, Southeast Asian developments, and geopolitical analysis. The site combines breaking news reporting, live television coverage, editorial commentary, and lifestyle content.

## Key Topics

- Iran-Israel conflict
- Oil prices and energy crisis
- Strait of Hormuz
- Asian markets
- Southeast Asia
- ASEAN
- Trump administration
- Middle East tensions
- Geopolitical tensions
- China infrastructure
- International relations
- Breaking news
- Cybercrime and scams
- NATO
- Regional news

## Core News & Platforms

- [Homepage](https://theomantimes.com): Homepage for The Oman Times news portal covering Oman and world affairs
- [Articles Hub](https://theomantimes.com/articles): Articles hub aggregating news content across multiple categories
- [Live TV](https://theomantimes.com/live-tv): Live broadcast streaming and video news content platform

## Geopolitical & Middle East Crisis

- [Iran Names Specific Gulf Sites for Attack After Israel Bombs South Pars](https://theomantimes.com/world/iran-names-specific-gulf-sites-for-attack-after-israel-bombs-south-pars-in-historic-strike): Breaking news on Iran-Israel military escalation and energy infrastructure targeting
- [Trump Calls Iran Strikes Unstoppable as Diplomatic Efforts Fail](https://theomantimes.com/world/trump-calls-iran-strikes-unstoppable-as-diplomatic-efforts-fail-to-slow-military-campaign): Trump administration escalates Iran military campaign amid failed diplomacy
- [Trump Calls NATO Allies Cowards by Omission Over Iran War Refusal](https://theomantimes.com/world/trump-calls-nato-allies-cowards-by-omission-over-iran-war-refusal): Trump's criticism of NATO allies regarding Iran military campaign participation
- [European Countries Say Hormuz Crisis Demands Talks, Not Trump's Warships](https://theomantimes.com/world/european-countries-say-hormuz-crisis-demands-talks-not-trumps-warships): European diplomatic response to Strait of Hormuz crisis and military deployment
- [Oil Soars, But Trump's War Is About Preventing Nuclear Catastrophe](https://theomantimes.com/world/oil-soars-but-trumps-war-is-about-preventing-nuclear-catastrophe): Analysis linking Trump's Iran strategy to nuclear prevention and oil market impacts

## Markets & Energy

- [Asian Markets Tumble as Iran War Keeps Oil Near $100, Shakes Rate-Cut Hopes](https://theomantimes.com/nation/asian-markets-tumble-as-iran-war-keeps-oil-near-100-shakes-rate-cut-hopes): Analysis of Asian market decline amid Iran conflict and oil price surge
- [Asian Shares Mixed as U.S. Stocks Hit Record Highs](https://theomantimes.com/nation/asian-shares-mixed-as-u-s-stocks-hit-record-highs): Market report on Asian stock performance amid US market gains
